blocks.html: In February of 2020, the ISO (International Organization for Standardization) approved a new version of C++, called C++20. C++20 contains the most changes to the language since C++11.

blocks.html_cs: V únoru 2020 schválila ISO (International Organization for Standardization) novou verzi C++ s názvem C++20. C++20 obsahuje nejvíce změn v jazyce od C++11.

blocks.html: For your interest, here’s a list of the major changes that C++20 adds. Note that this list is not comprehensive, but rather intended to highlight some of the key changes of interest.
